packs.name: Tidemark Island
packs.description: A quiet tropical island with open beaches, layered jungle, a thatched shelter and moving wildlife, built in Holodeck around the Cove.

packs.name: Courtyard
packs.description: A walled limestone plaza beside the Cove, with a tiered fountain, three statues, planted beds, benches and lanterns.

packs.name: Cove
packs.description: Holodeck’s starter Cove after its quality pass: a sheltered platform with a linen canopy, cushions, a hearth table, fern planters, a rug, a lamp and a mood board.

planned.name: Crescent Cove
planned.description: A tropical island that is still being built. Its assets join the gallery when the island is finished.

assets.name: Cove platform and seating shell
assets.description: The circular platform and curved seating shell that hold the rest of the Cove. Quality-pass revision with procedural texture maps, derived normals and packed roughness.

poster.alt: The circular platform and curved seating shell that hold the rest of the Cove. Quality-pass revision with procedural texture maps, derived normals and packed roughness.
